levels.surface: أبي الحسن صالح بن أبي حماد

notes: two isnads of the same tablet report meet at بكر بن صالح, and the names after him are written once and belong to both

«قال أبي عليه السلام لجابر» is the Imam (Baqir) speaking and acting in a narrated encounter with Jabir, and Jabir's «أشهد بالله» is a first-person account with implicit transmission (rule 11); whether the Imam or Jabir is a further link is not settled, so the chain stops at the Sadiq
the compiler's father «أبي» is a relation link in both routes; the occurrence numbers say which
the Imam «أبي عبد الله» is named inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator link
